offers_products.reason: Provides slot machines, redemption terminals and amusements, and sells games in Louisiana, South Dakota and West Virginia.

offers_services.reason: Operates, services and supports gaming terminals in venues, with compliance guidance, as a turn-key route operator.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Individual players choose and play the slot machines and terminals in bars and truck stops, generating the revenue.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Partners with bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops and fraternal organizations, and sells games to operators.

recurring_revenue.reason: Ongoing revenue share from terminals in established venues, with repeat player play and continuing placement agreements.

cyclical_demand.reason: Gaming play is discretionary and falls in downturns; venues are bars, restaurants, truck stops and convenience stores.

big_ticket.reason: Revenue is small, frequent play at terminals shared with venues; placement agreements are not large one-off purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from owned gaming terminals and licences placed in venues, not mainly from staff time.

large_customers.reason: Main partners are small local bars, restaurants, convenience stores, truck stops and fraternal organizations, plus individual players.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and operates large fleets of gaming terminals placed in thousands of locations, needing ongoing machine purchases, route vehicles and service.

notes: Mainly a route operator sharing terminal revenue; it also sells games in some states (Louisiana, South Dakota, West Virginia).
